decision: Selected the coordinates that Lunavi's own Cheyenne Data Center page embeds in its 'GET DIRECTIONS' link: the Google Maps place 'Lunavi' (listed under its former name 'Green House Data'), feature 0x876f3cad89b1a915:0x4a61f494305ad58a, at 41.1296651 N, 104.7408848 W (the '!3d/!4d' place coordinates, not the '@' viewport centre). The same link is present in the Internet Archive copy of 7 June 2026. The U.S. Census Bureau geocoder independently matches 340 PROGRESS CIR, CHEYENNE, WY 82007 (Laramie County) to an interpolated address-range point 26.2 m away. No parcel or building footprint was obtained: the Laramie County parcel viewer (Beacon) answered HTTP 403 and the City of Cheyenne GIS layers are hosted on a host whose robots.txt answers 403.

census_match.nature: interpolated along the TIGER address range; not a rooftop point

computed.method: Geodesic distances on WGS84 (pyproj 3.7.1 Geod). Coordinates transcribed from the operator page's link and the Census geocoder JSON; no transformation.
computed.coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude as published by Google Maps and the Census geocoder (NAD83 benchmark coordinates treated as WGS84 at metre level); no transformation.
